notes.title: Diana's Quest - Patch 1.2a
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. The patch 1.2a is now live. Check out what has changed.

BUG FIXES:
Dark Punishment: now enemies should disappear after they are defeated by this passive skill's effect.
Canyon Mountains: players should no longer get stuck in the first map after talking to Beatrice.

REBALANCING:
Excalibur: attack power has been doubled.
Mirror Shield: fixed to give +4 Magic Defense (instead of +4 Magic Attack).

PERFORMANCE:
Screen freezing: should no longer happen on monitors with a refresh rate higher than 60Hz.

Hentai Room Team

notes.title: Emergent Patch (Game returned to 1.1a)
